overview: The Medford City Council approved a home rule petition regarding casino host community agreement funds, addressed local matters including business district parking revenues, donation bin regulations, and street drainage, and referred items on senior tax deferrals, Chapter 40B developments, and Council legal counsel to committee.

items.title: Home Rule Petition on Casino Funds
items.summary: Approved a home rule petition to establish a special revenue fund for host community agreement casino funds subject to council appropriation.

items.title: Public Participation on Zoning and Finances
items.summary: Received and placed on file remarks from resident Robert Penta regarding city finances, municipal facility upkeep, housing projects, and zoning moratoriums.

items.title: Senior Property Tax Deferral Limits
items.summary: Referred a resolution to increase the income cap for senior property tax deferrals to the Committee of the Whole, and approved a motion to include program details in future tax bills.

items.title: Business District Parking Revenue Distribution
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration to locate and allocate parking enforcement funds designated for commercial district improvements.

items.title: Recognition of Rosemary Adagna
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating 2019 Citizen of the Year Rosemary Adagna on her 80th birthday.

items.title: Donation Collection Bin Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a proposal to draft an ordinance regulating donation drop boxes with permits and identification requirements, amending it to exempt school and municipal sites.

items.title: Chapter 40B Housing Applications
items.summary: Approved a resolution to examine pending Chapter 40B development proposals and passed a motion asking the city to explore hiring a developer-funded municipal advocate.

items.title: City Council Legal Services Funding
items.summary: Referred a proposal seeking funding for dedicated City Council legal counsel to an upcoming Committee of the Whole meeting with the mayor.

items.title: West Medford Square Drainage Remediation
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city engineering department correct a street drainage problem in front of businesses in West Medford Square.

items.title: Meeting Records and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meeting of January 21, 2020.
